cues.title: 红色从哪里来？
cues.titleEn: Where does the red solid come from?
cues.caption: 红色固体中的铜，来自原来的蓝色试剂。
cues.captionEn: The red solid contains copper from the blue reagent.
cues.zh: 梨样液变红，是被试剂染红了吗？先看同样处理的水空白，它没有出现红色沉淀。放大红色颗粒，追踪其中的铜：它们来自原先含铜的蓝色试剂。还原性成分提供电子，铜的价态从正二变为正一，进入砖红色的氧化亚铜固体。这里显示的是净变化，糖的后续反应没有逐一画出。新物质的形成，才是这一现象的关键。
cues.en: Did the reagent simply dye the pear sample red? The water blank receives the same treatment, yet forms no red precipitate. Zoom into a particle and follow its copper. It came from the blue copper-containing reagent. Reducing components supply electrons; copper changes from oxidation state plus two to plus one in the brick-red copper(I) oxide. This is a net account, with the later sugar reactions omitted. The key is the formation of a new substance.

cues.title: 蔗糖为什么不变红？
cues.caption: 检测识别反应性质，不能只凭“糖”的名字。
cues.captionEn: The test responds to chemical behavior, not the name “sugar”.
cues.zh: 蔗糖明明也是糖，却没有同样的红色沉淀。区别藏在连接方式里：葡萄糖保留了能开环、进入反应性形式的结构；蔗糖把两个这样的中心连接在一起。现在先单独水解蔗糖，再恢复相同的检测条件。你预测会怎样？水解得到的葡萄糖和果糖能够呈阳性。不是糖的名字变了，而是结构和反应性质变了。所以一次阴性，不能推出没有糖；判读之前，还要确认阳性对照确实有效。
cues.en: Sucrose is a sugar, yet it gives no comparable red precipitate. Look at the connections. Glucose retains a center that can open its ring and access reactive forms. In sucrose, both such centers participate in the glycosidic link. Hydrolyze sucrose separately, then restore the same test conditions. What do you predict? The resulting glucose and fructose can give a positive test. The changed structure changes the response. A negative result therefore does not mean no sugar, and the positive control must work before we interpret it.

cues.title: 橙色去了哪里？
cues.titleEn: Where does the orange dye go?
cues.caption: 有颜色的染料，更容易分配到脂肪中。
cues.captionEn: The colored dye preferentially partitions into lipid.
cues.zh: 花生薄片变橙，原因与刚才不同。看，苏丹染料还没接触脂肪就已经有颜色。放大一滴脂肪：这种亲脂性染料能在脂肪和周围液体之间来回交换，但会更多地分配到脂肪里。我们追踪的染料还是原来的染料，并没有把脂肪变成一种橙色新物质。富集的颜色让脂肪滴显形，不过周围的染液也会遮住细节。
cues.en: The orange peanut section tells a different story. Sudan dye is colored before it reaches the fat. Zoom into a lipid droplet. This lipophilic dye exchanges between the droplet and the surrounding liquid, but preferentially partitions into lipid. The tracked dye remains the same substance; the fat has not become a new orange product. The concentrated color reveals the droplets, although dye in the surrounding liquid can still hide their boundaries.

cues.title: 洗淡了，为什么更清楚？
cues.titleEn: Why does rinsing make the droplets clearer?
cues.caption: 背景变淡了，脂肪的数量没有增加。
cues.captionEn: The background fades; the amount of fat has not increased.
cues.zh: 洗过以后，脂肪滴更清楚了，是脂肪变多了吗？跟住同一颗脂肪滴，它的边界没有变。变的是背景：周围液体中的染料随着清洗液被带走，而脂肪暂时保留了较多染料。对比因此更明显。可是染料并没有永久锁在脂肪里。继续清洗，它也能逐渐离开。清楚的图像来自合适的对比，不等于样品含量增加。
cues.en: After rinsing, the droplets stand out. Has more fat appeared? Follow the same droplet: its boundary has not changed. Dye in the surrounding liquid leaves with the rinse, while the lipid temporarily retains more. That improves contrast. But the dye is not locked into the fat forever. With continued rinsing, it too can leave. A clearer image reflects better contrast, not an increase in the amount of fat.

cues.title: 紫色的铜，还是原来的价态吗？
cues.titleEn: Does violet copper have a new oxidation state?
cues.caption: 新物质、再分配、配位：变色的原因并不相同。
cues.captionEn: New substances, redistribution, coordination: color changes have different causes.
cues.zh: 最后看蛋清：双缩脲检测出现紫色，却没有刚才的砖红色固体。放大蛋白质的一段长链。在碱性条件下，链上的多个结合位置可以参与铜的配位，改变铜周围的环境和吸收光的方式。注意这个标记，铜仍然是正二价，并没有变成氧化亚铜中的正一价。现在回看三种颜色：新固体形成，原有染料重新分配，铜的配位环境改变。仅凭变色，不能判断是哪一种原因；还要看对照和发生变化的对象。
cues.en: Finally, the egg-white sample turns violet in the Biuret test, without the brick-red solid seen earlier. Zoom into a segment of the protein chain. Under alkaline conditions, several binding positions can coordinate copper, changing its surroundings and how the complex absorbs light. Watch the oxidation-state label: copper remains at plus two, rather than becoming plus one in copper(I) oxide. The three colors now have three causes: a new solid, redistribution of an existing dye, and a changed coordination environment. Color alone cannot tell them apart; the controls and the changing objects matter.

title.zh: 变红、变橙、变紫：颜色能证明什么？
title.en: Red, orange, violet: what can a color prove?

lead.zh: 从同样处理的样品与对照出发，追踪铜、染料和蛋白长链，分清三种显色的原因。
lead.en: Follow copper, dye and protein chains through matched comparisons to uncover three different causes of color.

question.zh: 变红、变橙、变紫，颜色能证明什么？
question.en: Red, orange, violet: what can a color prove?

lead.zh: 从同样处理的样品与对照出发，追踪铜、染料和蛋白长链，分清三种显色的原因。
lead.en: Follow copper, dye and protein chains through matched comparisons to uncover three different causes of color.

principle.zh: 还原糖促成铜的还原和氧化亚铜沉淀；苏丹染料在脂相中富集；肽链相关位点改变 Cu(II) 的配位环境。检测指向特定性质，阴性只有在条件和对照有效时才能判读。
principle.en: Reducing sugars promote copper reduction and copper(I) oxide formation; Sudan dye concentrates in lipid; peptide-related binding sites change the coordination environment of Cu(II). A test reports a particular property, and a negative needs valid conditions and controls.

question.zh: 蔗糖原来呈阴性；先水解，再恢复相同检测条件，应该预测什么？
question.en: Sucrose first tests negative. What should we predict after hydrolysis followed by the same test conditions?

explanation.zh: 水解得到的葡萄糖和果糖能表现还原性。与未水解样品和有效阳性对照一起比较，预期会出现砖红色沉淀；原阴性不能说明没有糖。
explanation.en: Hydrolysis yields glucose and fructose, which can show reducing activity. Compared with the untreated sample and a working positive control, a brick-red precipitate is expected. The original negative did not establish that no sugar was present.

curriculum.action: 保持现有全部 5 章，窗口本身无需扩大；问题在片内机制缺失。
curriculum.windowRationale: 删掉 negative-control 会失去“阴性≠无糖”的结构反例；只取 wash 会丢染料来源；只取 protein 又丢和还原性铜变化的关键对比。此教材活动一次涉及三类成分，保留全片最完整。

futureNarrowWindows.condition: 本章自身必须包括水空白、配位因果和 Cu(II) 不变的证据，不靠前章才能懂。

beats.visible: 梨样液与水空白位于同一温水浴，起初都含蓝色试剂。等候后只有样液有红色微粒。
beats.modelCause: sameAssayConditions + knownReducingCase; extent drives solid amount, not a whole-tube color toggle

beats.visible: 一粒红色沉淀成为放大锚点；原试管缩成身份明确的小背景，进入铜的前后状态配对视图。
beats.modelCause: stable Cu IDs mapped between reagent ledger and Cu₂O product units

beats.visible: 从含铜试剂状态连接到 Cu₂O 固体状态；Cu +2→+1 随每个铜的去向更新。含氧碱性体系提供 O；电子仅在独立账本中计入。
beats.modelCause: copperNetLedger: every product Cu has one net accepted electron; product Cu:O=2:1

beats.visible: 回到同一颗沉淀及原对照，沉淀由新物质组成，水空白未出现同样终点。
beats.modelCause: macroscopic solid quantity uses the same product ledger

beats.visible: 葡萄糖对照与未水解蔗糖并列：前者红色沉淀，后者没有。两者都写明“含糖”，不用甜味判据。
beats.modelCause: known sugar graph cases + matchedAssayEvidence

beats.visible: 只突出葡萄糖 C1 的可开环中心，蔗糖中葡萄糖 C1 与果糖 C2 经糖苷 O 相连。环的连接按真实键图；水解前不将蔗糖环打开。
beats.modelCause: anomericConnectivity(graph); glucose open-capable, sucrose both centers glycosidically engaged

beats.visible: 出现明确的“先水解”前处理视图；水分子参与断开糖苷键，保留 G1–G6/F1–F6 身份。随后转入“恢复相同检测条件”，再进入试剂比较。
beats.modelCause: sucroseHydrolysisGraph is distinct from assay warming; product atoms conserved

beats.visible: 水解前样本与已水解且条件匹配的样本再检测；后者产生红色固体。先留短暂停顿让观众预测，再显结果。
beats.modelCause: hydrolysis products enter known reducing cases; no fixed electrons-per-sugar yield

beats.visible: 保留未水解蔗糖的“含糖 / 本项阴性”双标记，删除“无糖”推论。
beats.modelCause: evidenceInference constrains the conclusion to the tested property

beats.visible: 花生薄片内脂肪滴尚不明显；旁边的染液已经橙色。相同颜色的染料标记沿液体接触边界进入。
beats.modelCause: fixed lipid geometry; initial dye mass in bath

beats.visible: 同一脂肪滴被放大：内部油脂长链与苏丹染料的简化结构帮助辨认疏水环境；分子不是向目标直线游走。
beats.modelCause: chemical identity glyphs + seeded reversible phase-transfer state

beats.visible: 相界面两向均有染料通过，脂相的单位体积染料逐渐较多；染料身份与颜色未变。手机只留一个界面局部和两个明确相标签。
beats.modelCause: twoCompartmentPartition gives both gross fluxes and net flux
beats.spokenReferent: 同一批染料的重新分配

beats.visible: 缩回原切片，固定脂肪滴更橙；同时承认周围也有染液背景，不凭饱和色块估含量。
beats.modelCause: same dye concentration state drives qualitative opacity

beats.visible: 保持上一章结束的视野位置与染料状态，先让观众认出同一颗脂滴。
beats.modelCause: wash starts from stain endpoint, not fresh random droplets

beats.visible: 清洗液通过切片，含染料液体进入吸水纸/收集区；被跟踪的染料沿连续路径离开，不以透明度凭空消失。
beats.modelCause: dyeRinse outflow and transfer ledger; total bath+lipid+collected dye conserved

beats.visible: 原脂滴边界叠加细线，与当前边界完全相同；背景低了，脂滴更容易辨认。
beats.modelCause: lipid area constant; concentration contrast increases during selected finite rinse

beats.visible: 标“继续清洗的示意预测”，时间尺度拉长后部分脂相染料也离开，脂滴仍在，颜色渐淡。
beats.modelCause: continued reversible partition plus open-system outflow

beats.visible: 蛋清样液显紫色，水空白不出现同样紫色。观察保持溶液状态，不出现上一章的砖红沉淀。
beats.modelCause: biuretEvidence + coarse complex fraction

beats.visible: 放大蛋白的一段连续肽链，C(=O)–N 的连接位置逐个显现；用长链上多个结合位置表达，不要求初学者记有机术语。
beats.modelCause: peptideGraph with stable atom/residue IDs; donor sites attached to actual backbone atoms

beats.visible: Cu(II) 配位前后，配位连线由实际供体位置导出，+2 标记保持。碱性体系的作用在局部示意明确；不把氮画成凭空出现或金属变色的原因全部归为铜原子颜色。
beats.modelCause: representativeCoordinatedMotif + binding occupancy; Cu oxidation state fixed at +2

beats.visible: 依次回看红色新固体、橙色原染料、紫色配位环境；每次仅一个主要对象和一个原因，最后停在“变色本身不能判定反应类别”。
beats.modelCause: mechanismIdentity = redox / partition / coordination; no second unrelated simulation
